items.description: 50 Pins of the first batch have screw fit heads without additional locking splints. If used in a non-rotating way, there is no issue. But if used in any manner which would rotate the pin (such as in a primitive or in a soft release) the rubber cord can prevent the pinhead from turning - if the pin is spun during this interaction, the pin can disassemble. The above mentioned problem can only happen to the pins that have the black head with 6 holes. The heads with 1 hole are not affected as they are assembled differently.
items.solution: Pins that have unscrewed will be replaced for free. For customers that want to regularly use the KingPin in a rotating system, Slacktivity is accommodating and will also replace those pins for free. This issue does not affect new products. Contact info@slacktivity.com
